phases.title: Kernel State Matrix and operation ledger console
Supervisor recovery, candidate and promotion console
Agent workers, model routing, memory and engineering views

design_rules: UI reads authoritative Kernel projections rather than local runner heuristics.
Readiness, recovery, and promotion states are evidence-backed.
Capability and trust state are explicit; model suggestions are not authorization.
M1 and 168-hour runs are represented as acceptance workloads, not separate control planes.

tasks.title: Kernel State Matrix and operation ledger
acceptance_requirements: identity, lifecycle, evidence, runtime revision, and decision state remain distinct
historical failures do not overwrite current operation state

tasks.title: Capability and trust matrix
acceptance_requirements: capability scope and trust level are visible
approval/denial is distinguishable from execution failure
capability actions retain operation identity and evidence

tasks.title: Supervisor recovery and promotion console
acceptance_requirements: candidate and stable runtime revisions are distinguishable
failed candidates remain inspectable without becoming active

tasks.title: Agent worker and routing view
acceptance_requirements: worker identity is ephemeral and separate from operation identity
model/provider selection and escalation are visible
